models.haiku: Simple, fixed-step or short tasks: spelling and grammar, formatting, lookups, renaming, short summaries, small routine file edits.
models.sonnet: Everyday work: drafting and editing, analysis, multi-step coding, research across a few files, building a deck or page.
models.opus: Hard or high-stakes work: architecture and design decisions, complex debugging, long strategy documents, ambiguous multi-part problems.
models.codex: Self-contained coding work that doesn't need Issam's skills: writing, fixing or refactoring code and scripts, running tests, small apps and tools. Runs on Codex with Issam's ChatGPT plan.
